title: Ultimate Puff Raspberry Sherbet Shortfill 0mg 100ml
description: Ultimate Puff’s Raspberry Sherbet combines fruity-sweet and tangy raspberry with a tongue-tingling tickle of lemony sherbet for a delicious all-day vape. These shortfill bottles contain 100ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 20ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill will give you 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the short fill bottle well.
